Appraiser remarks
Inspection of the front end shows a crushed bumper cover, a cracked grille and a bent
radiator support, alnog with a damaged hood latch and cracked headlamp mounts. The
pattern of crush and displacement lines up with the frontal impact the claimant
described, and the damage sits in the zones a head-on contact would reach. Nothing on
the vehicle points to older unrelated damage. The shop's invoices list each operation
once with no duplicate charges, and the labor hours are reasonable for replacing and
aligning the parts involved. The plan is to replace the bumper cover, grille, radiator
support and latch, refit the headlamps, then recheck alignment and cooling system
function before release.
